tracks.name: Multilevel-conditioned lightweight model
requirements: Three matched managed CUDA fits with fresh CPU restores
Tiny raw-residual and post-coarse controls with identical initial weights and native bank
Independent forward/objective qualification and deployed coarse-plus-fine parity
Full historical, new native and new spectral evaluation

tracks.name: Timestep correction reuse
requirements: Bounded recycled direction space with true-residual checks and geometry reset
Independent tests covering repeated, changed, unrelated, zero and invalid equations
Same-input sequence screen and independently advanced native rollouts
Fresh versus recycled work and repeated full-fluid timing

tracks.name: Explicit spatial wavelengths and rectangular geometry
requirements: Controlled cosine mode bands with declared physical wavelengths and operator-verified labels
Native-only versus spectral-augmented training contrast retaining the original bank
Independent native and wavelength evaluations after frozen selection

tracks.name: Inference and solver execution
requirements: Profile CNN, hierarchy, operators and native exchange on real requests
Implement and qualify measured optimization candidates against unchanged operator
Repeated same-core pressure and native-fluid timing including conversions, gates and reuse maintenance
Report accepted coverage separately from rejected attempt timing

architecture: Three bias-free linear 3×3×3 replicated convolutions, 1→4→4→1, plus fixed 1/8 Jacobi skip; 648 trainable parameters.
